description: This file defines a templated SocketServerType class within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It manages socket-based client connections, including handling client iteration, connection acceptance, message submission, and connection management (suspend, close, cleanup). It also defines nested classes for client iteration and socket handling, and provides methods for opening, closing, and managing socket clients.

classes.name: SocketServerType
classes.description: A templated class managing socket server operations, client connections, and message handling within the WPEFramework.

classes.name: IteratorType
classes.description: A nested class providing iteration over connected clients.

classes.name: SocketHandler
classes.description: A nested class managing individual socket connections, including accepting new clients, submitting messages, and connection control.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the socket server to accept connections.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the socket server and all client connections.

methods.name: Cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up closed or suspended client connections.

methods.name: Client
methods.description: Retrieves a client proxy by ID.

methods.name: Suspend
methods.description: Suspends a client connection by ID.

methods.name: LocalNode
methods.description: Sets the local node information for the socket server.

methods.name: Submit
methods.description: Submits a message/package to a client by ID.

methods.name: Clients
methods.description: Returns an iterator over current clients.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of connected clients.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the socket server for thread-safe operations.
